title: Loomground transport run
description: A conformance-vector run: activations, expected verdicts/master decisions, and the ordered verdict-labelled log trace.

repeat.description: determinism vectors only (conformance/README.md, Determinism vectors): the number of times a runner MUST evaluate `activations` against this vector's input.lg and check that every run's per-gate verdicts, master decisions and log equal `expected` and `log` (SPEC §7.5, rule 1).

file.description: path, relative to the vector's directory, to an `.lg` file denoting the same policy as input.lg with its declarations reordered (SYNTAX §2).

log.description: the ordered log trace this declaration order fixes (SPEC §7.4). Equal to the top-level `log` wherever the pipes admit a single topological order; where they admit several, the log §7.4 fixes for this file's declaration order (SPEC §7.5, rule 3).

permutations.description: determinism vectors only: one entry per declaration-order permutation of input.lg. A runner MUST evaluate `activations` against each `file` and check that the per-gate verdicts and master decisions equal the top-level `expected` (SPEC §7.5, rule 2) and that the log equals that entry's `log` (SPEC §7.5, rule 3).

token.description: optional: the declared token as presented, pinned per SPEC §7.4 where a vector tests that the record carries it alongside the host-observed facts.

observed.description: optional: the host-observed facts that produced this entry's effective kind/risk (SPEC §4, §7.4) — present only where a vector pins that the record carries both the declared token and the observation, not a reconciled value.
